name: KnitBone
source:
You play as Eden Cross, who suffers from chronic insomnia and feels disconnected from their life. One day, an old college acquaintance – Ryohei – shows up, pitching a miracle cure for your insomnia: 'an experimental therapy'.

That sounds suspiciously like what he also calls it… a 'guided ritual'.

[From [url=https://remarkablegames.itch.io/knitbone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演伊登·克罗斯（Eden Cross），他患有慢性失眠症，感觉与自己的生活脱节。有一天，一位大学老友良平出现，向你推销一种治疗失眠的神奇疗法：“一种实验性疗法”。

这听起来很像他所说的……“引导仪式”。

[来自[url=https://remarkablegames.itch.io/knitbone]Itch.io[/url]]
